mapper.sql: sys01_company_id AS company_id, sys01_company_nm AS company_nm, sys01_loc_nm AS loc_nm, COALESCE(sys01_use_yn, 'true') = 'true' AS use_yn, sys01_icam_company_cd AS icam_company_cd, sys01_note AS note
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sys01_company WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(CONCAT(sys01_company_nm,sys01_loc_nm,sys01_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
AND ( (#{useYn} = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys01_use_yn,'true') = 'true') OR (#{useYn} = 'false') )
ORDER BY sys01_company_id
SELECT FROM sys01_company WHERE 1=1 AND sys01_use_yn = 'true' AND UPPER(CONCAT(sys01_company_nm,sys01_loc_nm,sys01_note,sys01_icam_company_cd)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY sys01_company_id

SELECT sys01_company_id AS company_id, sys01_company_nm AS company_nm, sys01_icam_company_cd AS icam_company_cd, sys03_company_menu_id IS NOT NULL AS menu_yn, sys03_company_menu_id AS company_menu_id FROM sys01_company LEFT OUTER JOIN sys03_company_menu ON sys01_company_id = sys03_company_id AND sys03_menu_id = #{menuId} WHERE sys01_use_yn = 'true' ORDER BY sys01_company_id
mapper.sql: sys01_company_id AS company_id, sys01_company_nm AS company_nm, sys01_loc_nm AS loc_nm, sys01_biz_no AS biz_no, sys01_emgrcy_passwd AS emgrcy_passwd, sys01_start_date::date AS start_date, sys01_close_date::date AS close_date, COALESCE(sys01_use_yn, 'true') = 'true' AS use_yn, COALESCE(sys01_login_secure_yn = 'true', false) AS login_secure_yn, sys01_icam_company_cd AS icam_company_cd, sys01_icam_advis_company_cd AS icam_advis_company_cd, sys01_emp_info AS emp_info, sys01_office_tel_no AS office_tel_no, sys01_email_addr AS email_addr, sys01_note AS note
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sys01_company WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(CONCAT(sys01_company_nm,sys01_loc_nm,sys01_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
AND ( (#{useYn} = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys01_use_yn,'true') = 'true') OR (#{useYn} = 'false') )
ORDER BY sys01_company_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys01_company WHERE LOWER(sys01_loc_nm) = LOWER(#{locNm})
AND sys01_company_id != #{companyId}

mapper.update: UPDATE sys01_company SET sys01_company_nm = #{companyNm}, sys01_loc_nm = #{locNm}, sys01_biz_no = #{bizNo}, sys01_emgrcy_passwd = #{emgrcyPasswd}, sys01_start_date = #{startDate}, sys01_close_date = #{closeDate}, sys01_use_yn = #{useYn}, sys01_login_secure_yn = #{loginSecureYn}, sys01_icam_company_cd = #{icamCompanyCd}, sys01_icam_advis_company_cd = #{icamAdvisCompanyCd}, sys01_emp_info = #{empInfo}, sys01_office_tel_no = #{officeTelNo}, sys01_email_addr = #{emailAddr}, sys01_note = #{note} WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id IN #{id}
